contentPattern.structure: heading + supporting line + primary quote CTA + secondary links

suitableFor: inpage product hero banners on a full-bleed accent/brand-color background
product landing entry points with a quote CTA and a cluster of supporting links
image-less heroes where white text sits directly on a colored banner
notSuitableFor: heroes with a large photographic background image (use hero-quote)
heroes containing interactive form controls like ZIP/select inline (use hero-quote)
